annotations.title: Moderation sweep: scam-check up to 25 chat messages from one group at once

description: For moderation bots and support desks clearing a backlog (back-scan a Telegram / Discord group when your bot joins, sweep a moderation queue): up to 25 messages, each with the full single-message analysis (phishing domains, brand look-alikes, scam scripts in English and Chinese, leaked keys redacted). Plus: campaigns (the same bad host, fake brand or scam script across messages and senders), per-sender recommendation (ban_candidate / mute_and_review / watch), the ids to remove / hold / warn, and ONE pinned group warning in Chinese and English. $0.002 a message instead of $0.003. PAID: $0.050 per call or 50 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/scam-message-batch.

detail.description: compact (default): per-message verdict, action, hosts, signal codes and summary. full: also the complete per-message report (links, findings, replies).

messages.description: Up to 25 chat messages from one chat. Each item: {"id": "optional", "from": "optional sender", "text": "the message"}.

from.description: Sender name or user id (optional; enables per-sender counts)

official_addresses.description: Optional: your official contract / treasury / deposit addresses, comma-separated (max 20). Addresses in the messages that imitate them are flagged.

official_domains.description: Optional: your project's own domains, comma-separated (max 10). Confirmed as official; look-alikes of them are flagged.
